## Summary

Locate the connector built into the shift knob assembly for the OD button. [t1662]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Locate the connector built into the shift knob assembly for the OD button.
2. Cut longer lengths of wire to match the gauge of existing console wires.

_Procedure reported by [t1662]._

## Parts

- [Partial] Extended Wire Leads [t1662]

## Tips & gotchas

- Run the new wire leads from the console to the OEM switch on the knob. [t1662]
- Route wires through the seam between the shifter surround trim and gear indicator. [t1662]
